notes.987: Title: Lecture 33, Image Feature Extraction. No substantive content.
notes.988: Objectives: region, line and point features; dimensionality and robotic use. Roadmap only.
notes.989: Contents: region features, line features and point features. Roadmap only.
notes.990: Motivation: compact features support localization, grasping and navigation. Raw-pixel impossibility is overbroad; learned systems can learn their own features. Counts are illustrative.
notes.991: Camera-to-feature diagram explicitly includes edges, corners, object outline and motion vectors. Feature outputs may be scalars or vectors. Pose and velocity require suitable geometric or temporal context.
notes.992: Actual illustrations show near/far cube projection, car occlusion by a tree, lighting changes to a red ball and spurious shadows/reflections. Scene assumptions limit reliability; pixel area alone is not metric object size.
notes.993: Actual figures distinguish homogeneous regions, corridor line structure and distinctive point/corner features. Keypoints are not limited to corners.
notes.994: Original tourist-information sign versus segmented letters/symbols demonstrates object/background partition; robustness means graceful degradation when assumptions fail, not automatic text recognition.
notes.995: Region pipeline: pixel classification, instance segmentation, description. Otsu and local threshold t=mean(W)-k std(W) displayed. Weighted variance matters; this adaptive formula is not every library implementation.
notes.996: Read castle as float; t=.7 is overwritten by castle.otsu() before displayed threshold. Source Otsu value .6039 and histogram .603 are rounding. Adaptive h=15 caption says window size 15; API semantics need checking. Adaptive result visibly retains brick texture.
notes.997: Cone-response equations, primary mixing matrix, RGB normalization and light/reflectance/eye diagram inspected. Arbitrary luminance scaling must not disappear into unit color-matching functions. Mercury-line attribution for all three primaries requires qualification.
notes.998: XYZ uses imaginary primaries; normalized xy has two degrees of freedom. Actual xy versus Lab plots motivate approximate perceptual uniformity, not exact perceptual distances or complete illumination invariance.
notes.999: RGB to Lab then a*b* clustering removes lightness from clustering, not all illumination dependence. Green-red and blue-yellow axes, C-class k-means and color-constancy motivation inspected.
notes.1000: Four yellow targets but two chromatic clusters. Code uses gamma=sRGB, Lab a*:b* planes, k=2 seed=0. Actual cluster 0 is yellow/high b*, cluster 1 gray/near origin. Color-space centroids are not spatial object centers.
notes.1001: Inversion maps yellow class 0 to foreground255 and gray1 to background0; connected labels show four instances, top1/left2/right3/bottom4, background0. Label count return requires API checking. MSER and graph methods only named.
notes.1002: Raw spatial moment sum, binary area, centroid and central moments inspected. Nonempty mask and binary versus intensity-weighted interpretation must be declared.
notes.1003: Central moment identities, displayed J matrix, eigenvalue semiaxes, aspect ratio, orientation and Hu moments inspected. J is coordinate scatter, not unqualified mechanical inertia; atan loses quadrants; repeated eigenvalues lose unique orientation; Hu scale invariance needs normalized central moments.
notes.1004: Blob table and code inspected. Blob3 top centroid365.7040,218.2074 area5609.5 umin331 aspect.7489; index differs from connected label1. Fractional contour area differs from integer pixel count. J3 code references undefined u11/u02. Blue centers, red boxes and green ellipses visible; code explicitly plots only one J3 ellipse.
notes.1005: Boundary edgels, direction chain codes, circle circularity4piA/P², square contrast and centroid-radius signature. Chain start and diagonal metric matter. Raw radius sequence needs phase alignment for rotation invariance.
notes.1006: Code polar() uses blob0 but caption says blob3. polarmatch(1), radius normalization, perimeter shape/length and blob3 orange outline inspected. Plot x-coordinate is contour sample index, not theta. Normalized curves do not automatically align rotation phase.
notes.1007: Street diagram displays detector boxes and labels. Faster R-CNN description conflates box detection with pixel/instance segmentation; standard masks require a mask branch. COCO80 is a trained configuration, not universal architecture property.
notes.1008: Original street versus extracted line structure. Lines emphasize geometric boundaries useful in engineered environments without preserving color/texture.
notes.1009: Gaussian smoothing, derivative convolution, associativity, gradient magnitude and atan2 direction inspected, including two-branch gradient flow diagram.
notes.1010: Canny nonmaximum suppression along gradient direction and high/low hysteresis inspected. Weak chains connected to strong edges can survive; isolated weak responses do not.
notes.1011: Hough polar line equation rho=u cos(theta)+v sin(theta), normal-angle diagram and accumulator voting inspected. Theta is normal angle, not line direction; domain controls signed rho.
notes.1012: Five points, accumulator curves and Hough code inspected. h.lines(2) comment says minimum3 votes; strict threshold API must be checked before alleging a mismatch. Plot includes negative rho and multiple candidate lines.
notes.1013: Church Gaussian(5,5),sigma1.4; Canny50,100; probabilistic Hough100,min length200,max gap5,seed0. Actual images show dense edges then selected long segments. Canny default norm differs from explicit Euclidean theory.
notes.1014: Harris A=w*gradient-product matrix, eigenvalue flat/edge/corner cases and C=det(A)-alpha trace(A)^2 inspected. Gradients are filtered image derivatives, not Gaussian kernels alone. Ordinary Harris is not inherently scale invariant.
notes.1015: Scale-space volume, Gaussian differences and LoG motivation inspected. 26 neighbors means8 same scale+9 each adjacent scale. DoG approximates proportional scale-normalized LoG, not identical unscaled LoG.
notes.1016: SIFT detection, localization, orientation, descriptor pipeline inspected.16x16 patch,4x4 spatial cells,8 descriptor bins means128 dimensions; descriptor bins are not necessarily dominant-orientation assignment bins.
notes.1017: Harris nfeat500 and filtered SIFT percentstrength50,minscale5 code inspected. Figures show Harris crosses versus SIFT circles/angle hands. Percentstrength may be relative maximum, not top half count; API check needed.
notes.1018: Summary repeats region/line/point roles and overstates joint Harris/SIFT scale invariance; retain explicit qualification rather than universal guarantee.
notes.1019: Bibliography only: Szeliski, Corke, Forsyth. Named books have not been claimed read.
